text: Doing Great so far
Had a larger ice machine prior to this one. I like this machine but prefer the larger one for the office.
After following all instructions, the ice maker made 8 cubes over 2 hours and then refused to make any more.  Clearly I got a defective unit as others seemed to have considerably more luck (and ice).
We absolutely love it! It starts making ice in about 7 min!

We use a lot of ice! We have a fridge with an ice maker, which works great when it's just our family, but whenever we have guests--and that happens a lot--we run out, usually just when we are trying to get that last glass of water to take to bed. Sometimes we remember to buy a bag of ice if we have company coming, but that's always such a pain and that ice doesn't last long before taking on the "freezer" taste. This Della ice maker has been great! The selling point for me is that it makes a batch of the big ice cubes every 10 minutes. Now whenever we have guests, we just fill this baby with water and let it go. As long as it's running, there's always plenty of ice for everyone. When the guests leave, we just drain it, wipe it out, and save it for the next go around.

The only thing that I wish was better is the plug on the bottom. It's hard to find and pull out, and because it's basically just a piece of rubbery plastic, I'm nervous that it will be the first thing to break, which will make the machine completely unusable, because then it will leak everywhere. If that happens anytime soon, I'll definitely update this post.

I am tickled pink over this purchase. The Maker was delivered promptly, looks great, operates well and produces as advertised. My two questions to the seller were answered promptly and favorably. It produces 9 large cubes in approximately 5 minutes and they taste good and perform well in my beverage. Buyer should read the instruction manual and make sure they allow the Maker to set upright for at least an hour prior to placing in operation to allow the compressor lubricants to settle to the base and lubricate as designed. I was spending $3 daily for ice tea at lunch and takeout back to the office. Drink water at lunch now and pocket the $3. Payback on this Maker is 2 months for me. :-)
Love love love this ice maker! Perfect for daily large family use or get togethers!

A friend bought this ice maker for me after the one in my freezer died. I've owned it for about 2 weeks. My plan was to make ice and store it in the dispenser in my freezer. There is one issue. These cubes are stored at just about freezing, so they are a bit "wet". If I empty the basket directly into my dispenser, they freeze into one big lump. So I take the little basket of ice and put it in my freezer, then bounce it around to separate the cubes and load them into the dispenser. This works pretty well and gives me really cold cubes, which do a better job of cooling my drinks and don't dilute them as much.
Can't get away from the "wet ice" syndrome, as the ice is stored on the same compartment as the not-yet-frozen water. There is no temperature control, and if there were, the water would freeze before it could be made into cubes.
We got it sooner than expected. It is working great.

However, because the inside of the unit is actually not chilled, it started growing mold inside within a few weeks. It's very difficult to clean because there are small crevices where the water goes that you can't easily access or take apart. We bought pipe cleaners and began cleaning it at least once per week. However, within 5 months, the motor on the unit stopped working. It's now no longer operational. I contacted the seller here and they said that they won't replace the unit. It is absurd to me that after 5 months of sitting undisturbed on my counter it should stop working. So now I spent over $100 for an item I'm going to have to throw away.

I purchased this ice maker because the one in my refrigerator cannot keep up with me and my iced tea addiction. As soon as the product arrived, I washed it and set it up as directed. It took about 8 minutes for the first 8 cubes to drop (I selected the smaller portion size, which are about as large as a woman's finger). I let it sit for an hour and there was only enough cubs to fill a single glass so I opted for the larger size cubes (about one inch in diameter - I suspect my little ones might have melted). The larger cubes took just about as long t drop but did not melt as much. In just over two hours, I put my bounty into two ziplock bags... the ones that hold a sandwich.

The next day, I refilled the water, turned it on and took a shower and had much more ice waiting for me, so I am guessing on an inaugural run, it is pretty slow. It will come in handy for dinner parties. Now to clear my freezer and make rooms for more baggies of ice...

Pros: The ice maker is really efficient. And it gets more efficient after the first couple of batches. For my family purposes it is therefore more than enough. I did not find the ice to melt fast when kept in the bucket, but I have only used it inside my house during the fall so far.
Cons: I found it to be more noisy than what I expected from reading other reviews. It sounds like a fridge, though a small one. The other thing with which I was a little bit disappointed was the size of the ice. The small size is really small. The large one is acceptable though. A picture of a piece of ice that comes out when the large ice mode is selected is attached. And yes, it melts pretty fast, but I don't mind. It gets the drink cold, and I always put a lot of ice in my drinks anyway. I am accustomed to watery drinks. I am certain the other models available that use the same technology will have similar performance results.

In summary, I would say it is worth the price. Apart from the noise, the other reviews are pretty accurate.

I've had this ice machine for a few months now.  I'm an engineer, and I just love watching it make ice.  Purchase this unit with your eyes open, and you won't be disappointed.  When you open the machine, you'll notice a basket where the ice drops in after it's made.  Just below the basket is the water reservoir.  What this means is that this unit is not a freezer.  After the ice drops into the basket, you need to scoop it out and put it in a bag or whatever for your freezer - or use the ice as it's made.  After letting the ice refreeze in a freezer for ~30 minutes or so, break the ice up.  This will help prevent a solid ice brick forming.  I haven't had any problems with function as others have described, so I'm hopeful.  It doesn't take long for the first few ice cubes drop.  It's a lot faster than ice trays, and I don't want to have to go out and buy ice every time I run out. I've looked at quite a few units before settling on this one.  I traded some preferred functionality for cost, but overall I'm pleased with my purchase.

I purchased this product the 6/1/76. I've had ti running 24/7 once it arrived.
As w/ anything mechanical they never run forever and not have its problems.
First up. As w/ anything involving water. It's going for lack of a better word get 'GUNK' build up. Even if using filtered water which is highly recommended. I surmise this happens due to water recycling.
The walls of the water reservoir and water trough need to be cleaned of GUNK on a monthly basis of run 24/7 as I do run mine.
Most times all I clean it out w/ is paper towels held fast w/ a Hemostat. To get in between the refrigerating thingies that produce the ice.
A word of CAUTION at this point. Do not use any material that will leave some of itself (I.e.) LINT behind.
Lint leads me to my first problem w/ this unit. Plugged up the water outlet that fills the water trough & caused the water to miss the trough by redirecting the water coming from the water outlet that fills the trough. I had to remove it's outer back panel & top in order to remove the lint blockage from the water outlet. The second problem is that the sensor that shuts down the unit when the basket is full has stopped doing it's thing. Minor problems that I or anyone else can overcome w/ a little resourcefulness. All in all, I say this icemaker is a very good buy. But that is up to the individual to ponder.
